overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted professional presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated behavior research. With a total following of 3,580, his posts consistently achieve high engagement, driven by academic announcements, software releases, and career opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, publications, and conference presentations on computational methods for analyzing online coordination and information operations.
Recruitment posts for PhD students and postdoctoral researchers in computational social science.
Technical announcements regarding open-source tool updates, such as CooRnet v2.0.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's high engagement rate by increasing posting frequency and participating in active academic threads.
Utilize rich media, such as graphics or link previews, on LinkedIn to further boost the organic reach of recruitment posts.
Consistently incorporate relevant hashtags on Mastodon and Bluesky to improve content discoverability within the broader academic community.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky serves as the most engaging platform with an average engagement rate of 6.14%, showing a highly responsive audience for research publications and academic opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a highly focused but smaller niche audience (4.55% engagement), responding exceptionally well to technical software updates like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn has the largest audience base (1,850 followers) and drives the highest absolute volume of engagement, performing best with professional milestones like grants and job postings.
